title: AI in procurement: 85% piloting, few at scale
takeaways: 85% of Indian enterprise procurement functions pilot or use AI.
Only 14% of leaders say teams can use AI safely.
Digital Masters earn 3.2x returns on gen AI.
Only 8% use AI built into procurement platforms.
Just 30–40% of MSME procurement spend is digital.
source_note: Sources: Procol 2026; Deloitte 2025; Procurement Tactics 2026; India SME Forum 2026
